subject: Add static specifier to the internal functions of HLL (#2496)
reason: The change only adds the `static` specifier to internal functions in src/hyperloglog.c (MurmurHash64A, hllPatLen, hllDenseSet, hllCount, the merge/compress helpers, createHLLObject, isHLLObjectOrReply). It is a pure linkage/visibility refactor with no change to any function body, command reply, encoding, or data path; any remaining external reference to these symbols would break the build at link time, not at runtime. There is no behaviour change for a scenario to reach.
